overview_description.description: HealthKey operates in the insurance industry, focusing on healthcare. The company connects health insurers with healthcare providers and patients, aiming to make personalized healthcare more accessible. HealthKey works to address health inequities, which are avoidable differences in health between groups. It also focuses on the prevention, treatment, and management of illness, as well as the preservation of mental and physical well-being.

about_short_description.short_description: HealthKey is a platform that connects employers and insurers with health providers.

product.name: HealthKey Platform
product.description: A platform that connects employers and insurers with health providers, offering access to a variety of health services at discounted rates.

product.name: Employer Portal
product.description: A free portal for employers to manage employee health budgets and access to digital health providers.

product.name: Health Budget
product.description: A budget allocated by employers for employees to spend on health services through HealthKey, with the option for employees to add additional funds.

product.name: Discounted Health Services
product.description: Access to a wide range of health services at discounted rates, including neurodiversity care, LGBTQ+ wellbeing, pain management, fertility, and addiction support.

product.name: Employee Wellbeing Benefits
product.description: Tailored health and wellbeing benefits for employees, supporting recruitment, retention, and engagement.

product.name: Flexible Health Budgets
product.description: Employers can allocate flexible health budgets to employees, only paying for what is used.
